metadata.note: 1985 UK E02 GSX-R750F: four-stroke inline four, assumed conventional 180-degree crank and even 180-degree firing events; assumed cylinder order 1-2-4-3 is not verified from an F UK manual. Four headers merge into the single right-side stock silencer (F part 1430527A00; later G/H replacements are not the authored reference). All tube dimensions, two 23 mm exhaust valves and 285-degree seat-to-seat duration are engineering estimates. Collector and baffled silencer are approximated by straight pipes; no claim of measured factory audio.
